primary_network.name: Digital Economy
primary_network.fit: platform economy, digital market processes, consumer data, calculation, governance capacity, governmental digital initiatives, and plural empirical methods

secondary_networks.name: Accounting, Economics, and Law
secondary_networks.use_if: recognition rules, accounting categories, and institutional/legal measurement boundary become the dominant contribution

secondary_networks.name: Asian Capitalisms
secondary_networks.use_if: the manuscript becomes explicitly comparative about institutional measurement and platform capitalism in Indonesia/ASEAN

secondary_networks.name: Regulation and Governance
secondary_networks.use_if: the manuscript pivots toward state governance of visibility and data access

mini_conference.rule: Use a mini-conference only if an accepted 2027 theme is materially stronger than Network J; otherwise use Network J by the standing-network deadline.

contribution_frame: Different platform, corporate, statistical, payment, and administrative ledgers observe different units and recognition rules, constructing materially different views of the same digital economy; Invisible Ledger studies where those records diverge, where they can be reconciled, and what that implies for market measurement and state visibility.

empirical_dependency.candidate_policy: scope-labelled direct issuer longitudinal evidence separated from strict Indonesia-specific evidence
required_resolution: advisor explicitly ratifies the candidate inference architecture and CURRENT_STATUS is updated
or advisor selects a different final sample rule and IL reproducibility outputs are rerun under that rule

inference_boundary_after_ratification.direct_issuer_longitudinal: scope-labelled within-series Tokopedia/Blibli/Bukalapak evidence if ratified
inference_boundary_after_ratification.grab_shopee: conditional sensitivity unless thesis authority changes
inference_boundary_after_ratification.bps_bi_asean_global_administrative: separate modules, never one inflated N

execution_doctrine.next_action: close the Invisible Ledger advisor sample decision
